validation.reason: Native source or artifact changed. Run qualification before adding acceptance evidence.

bodyLifecycle.referenceOwnership: per-world marker without retaining disposed backend

spatialQueries.results: owned copies with world-scoped stable body references

rigidCore.jointEvents: joints over a force or torque threshold are reported after each step; breakable ones are destroyed then

batchedRays.result: closest hit per ray, ordered as the query sort orders hits (fraction, body handle, triangle, child); each ray is clipped just beyond its best hit so far, so equal-fraction hits are still compared and farther shapes are not tested. PhysicsWorld.castRays and raycastBatch use it

debugDraw.format: line vertex pairs: x, y, z, 0xRRGGBB as float32

rigidCore.checkpoint: joint flags travel in the bridge checkpoint (header flag bit 2); world settings and thresholds are part of Box3D's snapshot
rigidCore.filterJointRemoval: re-pairs the shapes of both bodies, so collision resumes at once

hullCache.key: exact float bits of the points
hullCache.result: hull bodies and compound hull children with the same points share one b3CreateHull call per context; the hull is the one b3CreateHull computes

rigidCore.worldCapacity: b3w_world_reserve(n) is passed to b3CreateWorld as capacity (n dynamic bodies and shapes, 4 n contacts) at the next reset; default contexts pass none
rigidCore.convexExtentLimit: for dynamic bodies, box half extents, hull points and compound polytope children above 1 km (from the body origin) are refused, and so is retyping a wider box, hull or compound body to dynamic: Box3D b3FindIncidentFace loops for ever on such boxes in contact (ND-1)
rigidCore.divergenceContainment: after each step a dynamic body that is not finite or faster than 10 x the maximum linear speed (at least 1e4) is put back at its previous pose at rest, the next step runs without warm starting, and event kind 7 reports it (ND-2)
rigidCore.restoreOwnHandles: b3w_world_restore_ex(takeHandles=1) takes the checkpoint handle table and keeps later slots free with newer generations; the adapter uses it for checkpoints the world wrote since its last reset (ND-3)

threaded.bridge: wasm/box3d_web.c compiled unchanged; b3CreateWorld and b3World_Step renamed per source
threaded.execution: one shared scheduler; worlds step one at a time on the calling thread, widening past an awake-body threshold

validation.reason: Threaded source or artifact changed. Run npm run test:threaded before adding acceptance evidence.
